column1: #   query            the phrasing sent to search_functions
#   expected         a fully-qualified Type.Member that MUST appear, or empty for snapshot-only
#   max_rank         the rank `expected` must appear within (1 = must be top hit)
#   note             why this row is here
# A row with no `expected` is not an assertion. It is here to be SNAPSHOTTED, so that a ranking change
# shows up as a git diff on Fixtures/ranking-snapshot-<version>.txt and someone has to look at what moved
# before re-blessing it. Most ranking questions have no single right answer, and pinning one would make
# every legitimate retune read as a regression -- see issue #82.
# Expectations are therefore reserved for cases with a DEFENSIBLE right answer: the query a past defect
# was reported against, plus the answer that defect's fix established. Do not add an expectation just
# because a query currently ranks something plausibly; that enshrines the status quo and makes the file
# an obstacle rather than an instrument.
# Regression rows: each of these is a defect that was reported, fixed, and must not come back.
